claim_rule: Claim a QRNG effect only after Holm correction and if its magnitude exceeds the maximum of all three seed-vs-seed contrasts; missing controls preclude the claim.
epsilon_rule: Report each primary's epsilon curve only for available biased arms; otherwise explicitly unavailable.
exclusion_rule: Exclude fallback/degraded/error/aborted samples from clean primary analysis; report taints, counts and sensitivity analysis separately; never delete artifacts.
intent_rule: Intent cosine unavailable until an exact embedding model revision and intention texts are frozen before generation.
margin_rule: max(card SESOI, pilot 95th percentile of absolute seed-vs-seed paired differences)
missing_margin_rule: No equivalence claim without a frozen SESOI and independent pilot differences.
pairing: card/prompt/epoch/told; labels permuted within prompt; prompt-clustered SEs
readiness_rule: Configured contrasts are conditional on supplied readiness and recorded provenance; missing/failed arm or endpoint readiness is not a measured zero. Epsilon contrasts require epsilon_supported.
source_family: Holm across all selected primary source tests, including unavailable members
stopping_rule: Fixed selected items and k for each available arm; no significance-based stopping; pilot excluded from full-run tests; interruptions and incomplete pairs reported.
supervised_family: Separate Holm family across the same primary endpoints for A vs B
supervised_unit: session; observers sharing a session are not independent replicates
unavailable_family_rule: Unavailable tests retain their family slots (p=1 for correction only, not fabricated measurements).
